title: Fix form schema props leaking to DOM element and overriding react-hook-form handler
body:
ObjectForm tests were failing because form submissions received SyntheticEvents instead of form data. SchemaRenderer spreads all schema properties as component props, which then get spread onto the HTML `<form>` element—this caused `schema.onSubmit` to override react-hook-form's `handleSubmit`.

**Changes**

- **Form renderer**: Implemented allowlist for HTML form attributes (data-*, aria-*, id, name, autoComplete, etc.), preventing schema properties from reaching the DOM element
- **Event detection**: Added `_reactName` check to catch React Synthetic Events
- **Cleanup**: Removed debug console.log from ObjectForm

**Technical detail**

Before:
```typescript
const { 'data-obj-id': dataObjId, ...formProps } = props;
<form {...formProps} />  // Spreads schema.onSubmit, overriding RHF
```

After:
```typescript
// Extract only HTML-valid attributes
const htmlFormProps = {};
for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(props)) {
  if (key.startsWith('data-') || key.startsWith('aria-') || 
      ['id', 'name', 'autoComplete', ...].includes(key)) {
    htmlFormProps[key] = value;
  }
}
<form {...htmlFormProps} />  // Schema props excluded
```
